query:
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO session_events
            (event_id, session_id, node_seq, event_type, payload_json, searchable_text, created_at)
        SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
         WHERE EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM sessions
              WHERE session_id = ?
                AND (deleted_at IS NULL OR ? = 1)
         )
